scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @cgawe/workbench run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @cgawe/workbench run dev
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/paper-glider-compat-smoke.mjs && node scripts/lowpass-canary-proof.mjs
scripts.lowpass:generate: npm run build:packages && node scripts/lowpass-canary.mjs --write && node scripts/lowpass-canary-proof.mjs --write && node scripts/lowpass-canary.mjs --write --require-proof
scripts.verify: npm run schema:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run runtime:check && npm run compat:check && npm run lowpass:check && npm run test:browser && git diff --check
